findings.title: Digest reports healthy when evidence coverage is absent
findings.where: src/lib/digest.ts:168-189 and src/lib/digest.ts:236-241; behavior is locked by src/lib/digest.test.ts:213-216.
findings.what: topPerDomain defaults every missing coverage signal to `healthy`, and digestVerdict accepts only recommendations, so `digestVerdict([])` emits `No findings — your recent agent activity looks healthy` even when no evidence was loaded or domains are blind spots. The claim is therefore not reproducibly backed by coverage provenance.
findings.fix: Require coverage when producing the overall verdict, or return an uninstrumented/unknown verdict whenever required domain coverage is absent, sparse, or blind. Remove the implicit healthy fallback for claim-producing callers.
findings.acceptance: Add a test passing an empty recommendation list with absent or CANNOT_SEE coverage and assert the verdict is unknown/needs-data rather than `ok` or `healthy`; retain an `ok` verdict only when required domains carry PROVE coverage.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial re-read confirmed the fallback is explicit at src/lib/digest.ts:188, the healthy sentence is unconditional for recs.length === 0 at lines 236-241, and the dispatched test explicitly expects that empty-list healthy outcome.

findings.title: Persisted doc-hygiene artifacts are accepted without commit binding
findings.where: src/lib/doc-hygiene-artifact.ts:195-199 and src/lib/doc-hygiene-artifact.ts:250-255; missing coverage in src/lib/doc-hygiene-artifact.test.ts:63-74.
findings.what: The parser claims malformed or stale persisted values return null, but `options` defaults to an empty object and the commit comparison runs only when expectedCommit is truthy. A schema-valid artifact can therefore be accepted without proving it belongs to the runtime checkout, allowing historical findings and scores to be presented without an `as of` demotion.
findings.fix: Fail closed unless expectedCommit is present and valid, then bind the artifact commit to it; if unbound artifacts must remain consumable, return explicit stale/unverified provenance that downstream claim code must demote.
findings.acceptance: Add a test asserting `parseDocHygieneArtifact(artifact())` and calls with null/empty expectedCommit return null (or an explicitly unverified result), while matching current commits pass and mismatches fail.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial re-read confirmed the default options object at lines 196-199 and the truthy guard at lines 250-255 bypass all commit validation when expectedCommit is absent; the existing stale-artifact test covers only a supplied mismatch.
